summary: First-finish smoke tests for DACOT MVP. Backend: auth (login/me/401), products CRUD + soft delete, customers CRUD, order creation with percent discount (subtotal 110, disc 11, total 99 verified), empty-items 422, inactive-product 400 with expected PT-BR message, price snapshot preserved after product price change, status transitions valid/invalid enforced (409 for invalid), duplicate creates new order with incremented order_number and status='new', cancel sets status+cancelled_at, edit blocked (409) when delivered, stats endpoint, filters by status. Frontend: login page (invalid creds handled by 401), dashboard with kanban + metrics + revenue, new-order flow adds products and submits successfully redirecting to detail page with advance/cancel buttons, history/products/customers pages load with expected testids.
passed: Order create with percent discount: totals correct in reais (110/11/99)
Inactive product -> 400 with 'Produtos inativos nao podem ser vendidos'
Price snapshot: order item unit_price unchanged after product price updated to 999
Duplicate order returns 201, new order_number (1005), status=new, items copied
Cancel order: status=cancelled, cancelled_at set, order remains in DB (listed via ?status=cancelled)
PUT edit: 200 while new, 409 after delivered
Frontend login redirects to /, invalid creds produce 401 (no visible error component but backend rejects)
Dashboard shows metrics (Novos/Em preparo/Prontos/Entregues/Faturamento) and 3-column kanban
New Order: product-search-input, add-product-<id>, submit-order-button all functional; submit redirects to /pedidos/<id>
Order Detail shows advance-to-* and cancel-order-button
Nav to Historico/Produtos/Clientes all render with expected testids

failed.issue: duplicate order response does not include 'duplicated_from' field (per PRD requirement). Field may be stored but not serialized in OrderOut.
failed.evidence: POST /api/orders/{id}/duplicate response JSON has no 'duplicated_from' key

failed.issue: Invalid credentials: no visible error message rendered on the login page (backend correctly returns 401)
failed.evidence: After submitting admin@dacot.app/wrong, no .error/[role=alert] element with text was found on page

action_items: Consider including 'duplicated_from' in the OrderOut response model so the UI can show provenance
Show a user-facing error toast/message on the Login page when POST /api/auth/login returns 401
